warnings: S1, S2 and S2(ช่วงสั้น/short-span variant) all print variable main-bar spacing across the slab width (denser near mid-span/interior strip, sparser near the edge strip) rather than one uniform spacing — recorded per §0.5's variable-spacing convention: spacing_mm = the smallest printed value, variable_spacing:true, full detail in note.

S2 is printed twice with two different spans under the SAME mark: '(ช่วงยาว)' (long span, 4.00m) and '(ช่วงสั้น)' (short span, 2.00m) — both recorded as separate elements sharing the mark 'S2', per the two-way-slab convention of naming both directions with one mark.
